reply.text: {"say":"Pure arm pump, all high reps in the 15 to 20 range with nothing heavy: biceps and triceps trade off so the pump builds fast.","title":"Arm Pump","days":[{"name":"Arm Pump","exercises":[{"key":"cable-triceps-pushdown","sets":3,"reps":15,"repsTo":20,"seconds":0,"group":"A","part":"main","note":"Squeeze hard at the bottom"},{"key":"cable-biceps-curl","sets":3,"reps":15,"repsTo":20,"seconds":0,"group":"A","part":"main","note":"Control the lowering"},{"key":"cable-overhead-triceps-extension","sets":3,"reps":15,"repsTo":20,"seconds":0,"group":"B","part":"main","note":"Stretch deep, keep elbows in"},{"key":"dumbbell-hammer-curl","sets":3,"reps":15,"repsTo":20,"seconds":0,"group":"B","part":"main","note":"Stay light, no swinging"},{"key":"band-triceps-pushdown","sets":2,"reps":15,"repsTo":20,"seconds":0,"group":"C","part":"main","note":"Constant tension, short rest"},{"key":"band-biceps-curl","sets":2,"reps":15,"repsTo":20,"seconds":0,"group":"C","part":"main","note":"Squeeze at the top"}]}],"unmet":[]}
